scientific_integrity: The universal criterion and robust realization are analytically proved. The finite exhaustive and constructed tests are ancillary checks, not replacements for proof. Publication priority is based on accessible-source comparison and remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Classification only for one shared nonnegative additive valuation on a finite star; no claim for heterogeneous preferences, arbitrary graph families, or the graph-level universal-spectrum conjecture. Earlier literature might contain related unindexed results.
title: Arbitrary fixed-instance EF1 feasibility patterns on weighted stars
